project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase + Tailwind CSS HR management application
build_system: Next.js with npm - standard next build
test_framework: No test framework configured (no jest/vitest in package.json)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and Next.js static analysis passes
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm packages available. No Supabase CLI available for migration testing. Vercel auto-deploys from GitHub main branch.
contribution_requirements: Code in English, UI in French. Use 'use client' directive for interactive components. Tailwind CSS only for styling. Must update src/data/project-health.json after changes. Commit messages: type: description format.
key_patterns: Client components with 'use client' directive, createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client for browser Supabase access, lucide-react for icons, slate/blue/white color scheme with rounded-lg shadow-sm cards, pages are colocated in src/app/<route>/page.tsx, shared components in src/components/. Existing reports page has CSV and PDF export via window.print(). The app uses AppShell layout wrapper.
directory_structure: src/app/ contains route folders (dashboard, employees, absences, reports, remuneration, governance, schedules, settings, assets, login). src/lib/ has supabase client and calculations. src/components/ has shared components (encoder-drawer, layout/AppShell). src/data/ has project-health.json. supabase/migrations/ has numbered SQL migrations (001-019 exist). docs/ has database-schema.md.
